color.space: sRGB IEC 61966-2-1 nonlinear uint8 -> linear sRGB -> XYZ D65 -> CIELAB
color.lab_range: L* nominally [0,100]; signed a*,b* unscaled and unclipped; matrix rounding may exceed nominal L* bounds

clustering.initializer: sort (a,b,y,x) lexicographically; first center is lower median sorted point; subsequent centers maximize minimum squared distance to selected centers; ties choose lexicographically first
clustering.update: arithmetic mean in lexicographic pixel order using all eligible pixels
clustering.degenerate: eligible count < 3 or distinct (a,b) count < 3 => REVIEW/cluster_degenerate
clustering.empty_cluster: REVIEW/empty_cluster; no random restart or replacement
clustering.canonical_labels: sort final centers by (mean a,mean b,original index)
clustering.dominant: largest eligible population; ties choose lowest canonical index
clustering.compactness: Euclidean a,b distance to cluster mean: RMS, median, P90; numpy linear percentiles

target.definition: dominant component-wise median a*,b*; C=hypot(a,b); h=atan2(b,a) modulo 360; h=null when C<=achromatic_chroma_epsilon
target.lightness: dominant median observed L* only; not a fixed target-token lightness
target.notice: Provisional measurements only; not approved downstream targets; no scientific PASS gate

qc.layout: 3 columns by 2 rows; panel labels above images
qc.scatter_sampling: lexicographic (a,b,y,x) order, evenly spaced integer indices; display only; all eligible pixels used for computation
